question: Does per-head disruption cost scale with R² amplitude within each model?
primary_hypothesis: Spearman r(mean-bin-R², per-head disruption cost) > 0 in Llama and Mistral, indicating R² amplitude predicts load-bearing beyond head count.
primary_endpoints: Fraction of monotone bin-to-bin increase steps
secondary_endpoints: Per-bin true vs permuted and norm-matched delta comparison
Cross-model gradient: Llama > Mistral > OLMo in dose-response slope
inclusion_exclusion_rules: Only heads with available kernel data included
Bins with fewer than 10 heads excluded from Spearman calculation
acceptance_criteria: Spearman r > 0 and p < 0.10 in Llama and Mistral => supported
r > 0 in at least one of {Llama, Mistral} => supported_with_caveat
fallback_interpretation_if_null: Disruption cost is independent of R² within models; the grouped ablation result reflects head count, not SI amplitude → weakens SI-specificity claim.
